title: POST /api/sales/ingest — request body
description: Headers: Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>, x-verification-receipt: <timestamp>.<hex HMAC-SHA256 with the network secret>. Identity, commission and settlement fields are server-owned: sending any of them is rejected (client_identity_field_forbidden / client_financial_field_forbidden / client_field_forbidden). amountMinor is YER in minor units and must be a whole riyal. saleUuid is preferred; saleId is the legacy alias and must equal it when both are sent. Responses: 201 CREATED, 200 ALREADY_EXISTS_ACKED (same payloadHash), 409 conflict (same id, different payload).
